title: Website to WhatsApp Lead Bridge
goal: Build contact form that captures leads from website and creates SSOT contact for Panditji to follow up via WhatsApp.
result_summary: Created ContactForm component (name, phone, email, message) that POSTs to /public/contact. Backend upserts Contact (source: 'website', type: 'UNKNOWN') and creates Interaction (channel: 'website', event_type: 'form_submit'). Shows success message 'Panditji will contact you on WhatsApp shortly'. Contact page (/contact) shows all contact methods (WhatsApp, Call, Email) with note about single number for all services.
